# Ambiguous basename link: `[[shared-name]]` is ambiguous between
# kb/notes/alpha/shared-name.md and kb/notes/beta/shared-name.md, so neither
# candidate has an unambiguous inbound link and `akb orphans` reports both of
# them (plus the source page, which nothing links to).

exec akb init link-orphan-kb
cd link-orphan-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

stdin ../alpha-note.md
exec akb write alpha/shared-name.md

stdin ../beta-note.md
exec akb write beta/shared-name.md

stdin ../source-note.md
exec akb write source-note.md

exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/alpha/shared-name.md'
stdout 'notes/beta/shared-name.md'

-- alpha-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Alpha Note
summary: First note
tags: linktest
---
Alpha content with [[shared-name]].

-- beta-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Beta Note
summary: Second note
tags: linktest
---
Beta content with [[shared-name]].

-- source-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Source Note
summary: Links to ambiguous target
tags: linktest
---
This links to [[shared-name]] and [[nonexistent-page]].
